outputs.explanation: Panel A is a domain schematic and western blot image, not a quantitative plot with significance symbols.
Bar charts show percent depletion and log2 elution values with no asterisks or other significance symbols present, and no statistical comparisons are claimed.
Heatmap displays normalized abundance values with a color scale; no significance symbols appear on the panel or in the caption.
Violin plots show distributions with dotted reference lines and an orange circle marking HTT; no significance asterisks or symbols are used.
Bar plots with individual data points and mean±SD are shown, but no significance symbols (e.g., asterisks) appear on the panel or are mentioned in the caption.
Panel F shows a sequence alignment and a predicted crystal structure image, not a quantitative plot.
Scatterplots use colored circles to denote categories (HTT, consortium hits, etc.) but contain no statistical significance symbols.
Scatterplot reports an R² correlation value; no significance symbols are present.
PCA scatterplot shows data points grouped by shape/color legend; no significance symbols are present.
PCA scatterplots (striatum, cortex, cerebellum) show grouped data points; no significance symbols are present.
